answer: Operator Liability Escrow: each agent action posts a fee into an escrow keyed to the operator’s cipher, not the wallet. If linked identities exceed a diversity threshold, the operator’s whole escrow pool is slashed and future registrations quarantined under an umber freeze. Fresh wallets gain nothing; the attacker pays the full pool plus a per-identity penalty each time, making mass identity creation cost the operator directly from their orchard of accounts.
